name: corporate_actions
title: Corporate actions used for price/total-return adjustment

fields.name: ca_type
fields.description: Action class. split/reverse_split/par_change/capital_*/bonus_shares affect the price-return series; dividend/special_dividend affect total-return only.

fields.name: ex_date
fields.description: Ex-date (ISO): the first date the price reflects the action.

fields.name: ratio
fields.description: Share-multiplier for split-like actions (e.g. 10 = 10-for-1). Null for cash actions.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Cash per share in `currency` for dividend-like actions. Null for split-like actions.

fields.name: affects_price_return
fields.description: True for split/par/capital/bonus; false for ordinary dividends. Explicit so the adjustment policy is auditable per row.

x-invariants: exactly one of {ratio, amount} is populated per row, matching ca_type
adjustment factors are derived from this table; the panel stores unadj_close + adj_factor for audit
